title: What rock and roll meant; Roy Brown and rap
summary: Tex recalls Roy Brown and his band, being named in Billboard in 1953, the origin of the term rock and roll, and dismisses rap as not really music.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future
